title: Beautiful
text: Beautiful. I guess I didnt read the description very well because I was expecting this to be a plastic pot in the holder. Its a beautiful white ceramic like a mini bathtub lol.the hanger that comes with it is a shiny gold tone and will look very pretty when I hang it outside in the better weather. It also comes with another hook in case you need to hang it on a different hanger other than a shepherds hook. Such a nice quality product that was very well packed.
